note: Okmulgee County publishes no queryable zoning service. The City of Okmulgee's only zoning map is a Google My Maps viewer (polygons with zone codes as layer names, no ArcGIS REST service or GeoJSON/shapefile download). Its ArcGIS Online 'City of Okmulgee Zoning and City Limits' web map holds a 2015 zoning layer embedded without a service URL. No county zoning layer found; Henryetta's planning page says no zoning map is yet adopted.
